translation.name: Te akʼaʼj tuʼjal tuj tuʼjal qtata Dios

book.name: Kye Aj Galasy
book.title: Te Stz'ib'en Pa'k Kye Qerman Aj Amaq' Galasy

content: Jun Limb'il
Wetz a'in Pa'k tky'ixel Jesukrist; wetz nya'tx xjal lajol wetz sinoke lajomin tzan Jesukrist b'ix Qtata Dios aj ojaw anq'insan tetz.
Wetz b'ix kye kyaqil qerman aj akyeqet wuky'i'l tzani nxik qsama'na ja u'jni te etetz ekyaqil aj b'uch'uj qerman ja'chq tuj tkwentil Galasy.
Qtata Diosxwit b'ix te Qajaw Jesukrist tzaj sinxwit jun nim b'an galan etajsik etetz, b'ix qet kchewsa'xwit ek'u'j.

Te Jesukrist oxik tq'apo' tib' tzan tkamik tzan tpaj te qchoj b'ix ikxji tzan tkolpin qetz ti'j te nya'tx galan kxol kye xjal aj twitz ja tx'o'tx'ni; oqet tk'ulu' ikxji iktza'x tgan tuq te Qtata Dios aj ntzaj qna'o',
aj jiq'b'a' te jun-ele'x. Intky'ikxwit ikxji.
Te Pa'k Nb'isun Tuq Tzan Tpaj Kye Xjal Nkaj Tuq Kykola' Te Tpakb'alil Ti'j Jesukrist

Wetz b'an nkyinlab'an tzan tpaj ikja'n naj tkaj ekola' te Qtata Dios, te Qtat aj okxtzaj tuk'le' tzan tpaj te aj nim b'an galan aj ntzaj tsi' tzan tpaj te Krist anke k'onti'l nqajo', b'ix ajna'l ikja'n txik etoksla' junky tpakb'alil [aj nya'tx b'an'ax],
nya'tx tzan tpaj at-wit junky tpakb'alil galan sinoke cha ate' xjal aj kygan tzan tna'non etanim b'ix tzan tjaw kky'ixpu' te tpakb'alil ti'j Krist.
Qa jun-wit te qetza qatzun jun ángelji aj tuj ka'j oxe'l tpakb'a' junky tpakb'alil aj nya'tx iktza' aj oje xik qpakb'a'na etetz, intpon najsa' tzan te Qtata Dios.
Iktza'x oxik jq'uma'na etetz tb'ay b'ix ajna'l oxe'l jq'uma'na junky'el, qa at-wit junky oxe'l pakb'an junky tpakb'alil nya'tx iktza' te aj oje tz'ok echa'o', intpon najsa'x tzan te Qtat.

Wetz k'onti'l nkyinjoyon tzan wel galan tuj kywitz xjal sinoke tzan wel galan tuj twitz Qtata Dios. Cha nkyinjoyon-wit tzan wel galan tuj kywitz xjal, nya'tx-tal a'in q'apo' wib' nkyin'aq'unan te Krist.
Te Tpakb'alil Aj Ntpakb'a' Tuq Te Pa'k Nya'tx Jun Tidi' Aj Xkonoli'x-wit Titza'
Ntons waq erman, wetz ngan tzan txik nq'uma' etetz, te tpakb'alil aj oxik npakb'a' etuky'i'l nya'tx jun tidi' aj cha tuj twi' jun xjal.
B'ix ax nya'tx jun xjal otzaj q'uman te wetz ja tpakb'alilni b'ix nya'tx jun xjal otzaj xnaq'tzan te wetz, sinoke axk te Jesukrist otzaj tyek'u' wetz.

Etetz oje tz'ok echa'o' titza' tuq kyinnab'lin wetz oqtxi' aj tzunx tuq eq'i' witza' aj eq'i' kyitza' kye nxjalil aj tijajil Israel. Komo wetz ejaw nlajo' tuky'i nq'oj kye aj nkye'okslan tuq ti'j Jesukrist b'ix tidi'chq tuq nk'ulu' tzan kyponaj.
B'ix wetz mas tuq n'ok nsi' nk'u'j kywitz kye txq'anky wamoj aj tijajil Israel; wetz n'ok tuq nsi' nk'u'j tzan txik kyin kye qxjalil cha a'ox iktza'x oqtxi'.
Per aj wel tjoyo' te Qtata Dios atx aj man tuq atin tuj nb'o'til, tetz inxik tuk'le' nya'tx tzan tpaj-wit jun nk'ulb'en galan sinoke tzan tpaj tganx tuq tetz ikxji.

B'ix tzan tpaj owel galan tuj twitz, otzaj tyek'u' te Tk'wa'al [tzan tok wotzqila'] tzan txik npakb'a' ti'j Tk'wa'al kxol kye aj nya'tx tijajil Israel. Wetz k'onti'l inxwa'q cha'ol jun konsej tuky'i nijunwt
b'ix ax k'onti'l inxwa'q
Jerusalen q'olb'el kye aj tky'ixel Jesukrist tb'ay nwitz wetz, sinoke inxik tkwentil Araby b'ix yaji inmeltz'jikky tuj Damask.
Ya ma ky'ik oxe aq'b'i, inxwa'q Jerusalen q'olb'el Xhpe'y b'ix inkajten jweb'lajuj q'ij tuky'i'l
per k'onti'l e'ok wen kye txq'anky tky'ixel Jesukrist, sinoke a'ox te Chaw aj titz'in Qajawil.
Ti'j kyaqil aj nqet ntz'ib'a' etetzni, Qtata Dios nka'yin wi'j, wetz k'onti'l nkyinnik'on.
Yaji inxik tuj tkwentil te Siry b'ix Silisy,
b'ix nya'tx tuq otzqimin tuj tkwentil Judey tzan kye b'uch'uj qerman tzi aj mojb'a' kyib' tuky'i Krist,
a'ox ojetq tuq tz'ok kcha'o' wi'j ikxjani: “Te aj nqojaw tuq tlajo' tb'ay, ajna'l nxik tpakb'a' te tpakb'alil aj tb'aya' tgan tuq tzan tpon tnajsa'.”
Ntons b'an nqet tuq kyjiq'b'a' Qtata Dios tzan npaj wetz.
